stories.title: oRPC router with 5 procedures + x-llm
acceptance: apps/tasks/lib/router.ts exports oRPC router with 5 procedures: listTasks, getTask, createTask, updateTask, deleteTask
Each procedure has .route() with method, path, and spec callback using xlm() from @opentools/orpc/metadata
listTasks: GET /tasks, auto approval
getTask: GET /tasks/{id}, auto approval
createTask: POST /tasks, per-call approval
updateTask: PATCH /tasks/{id}, per-call approval
deleteTask: DELETE /tasks/{id}, per-call approval, destructive: true
All procedures use Zod schemas from lib/schemas.ts for input/output
